name: Porta Cabin
description:
Porta Cabin — Factory-Built, Site-Ready in 7-21 Days

Your project starts in a few weeks. You need a structure on site fast — something that goes up in a day, holds up through the project, and doesn't need babysitting.

That's what SAMAN porta cabins are built for.

We are a porta cabin manufacturer based in Bangalore. MS frame construction. Delivered and erected across South and North India in 7-21 working days. Sizes from 10×10 ft to 20×40 ft. Starting at Rs 2,15,000.

If you're a site contractor, project manager, or construction company sourcing for an active project — you're in the right place.

What Is a Porta Cabin?

A porta cabin is a factory-built, ready-to-use steel cabin that arrives at your site fully assembled and finished. Because it is built in a controlled factory and then transported, you get a usable room, office, or unit in days instead of weeks — with none of the mess, delay, or weather dependency of on-site brick construction.

At SAMAN, we manufacture porta cabins (also written "portacabin") in-house at our own units, not source them from a marketplace. That means we control the steel frame, the panels, the fit-out, and the finish. A porta cabin from us is a complete working space: framed, insulated, wired, and ready for the door to open on day one.

Buyers use the terms porta cabin, portacabin, and portable cabin for broadly the same product. Whatever you call it, the job is the same — a strong, movable, weather-ready cabin that can be relocated when your site or need moves.

Porta Cabin Construction & Materials

What makes a porta cabin last is what goes inside the wall, not the paint on the outside. Here is how ours are built:

  • Frame: A welded mild-steel (MS) structural frame carries the whole cabin and lets it be lifted, transported, and relocated without cracking. Exact section sizes are specified to suit your cabin size and use, and are confirmed at quotation.
  • Wall panels: Insulated sandwich panels (PUF / EPS / rock-wool core options depending on your heat, sound, or fire needs) or single-skin sheet, selected to match your budget and climate. Panel type and thickness are confirmed at quotation against your requirement.
  • Roofing: GI / single-skin or insulated roofing with proper slope and overlap so monsoon water runs off cleanly and the interior stays dry.
  • Flooring: Marine-ply, cement board, or steel-base flooring options, finished with vinyl or your chosen surface.
  • Doors & windows: Steel or aluminium doors and windows, with grills, sliding, or fixed options as needed.
  • Services: Electrical points, lighting, fan/AC provision, and plumbing points are built in where you need them, so the cabin is usable the moment it lands.

Because every one of these is a choice, not a fixed template, you get a cabin engineered for your site — not a one-size box.

Common Porta Cabin Sizes

Porta cabins are made to order, so the size follows the job. Common starting footprints run from compact single-person cabins around 10 x 10 ft up to larger multi-room units, and several cabins can be joined for bigger offices or accommodation blocks.

A few practical points buyers ask about:

  • Single units are sized to stay within road-transport width limits so they can be delivered fully built.
  • Larger requirements are met by joining multiple units on site.
  • Exact dimensions, height, and layout are set to your requirement and confirmed at quotation.

If you already know your rough size, mention it in your enquiry and we will guide you to the most cost-effective configuration. For a deeper breakdown, see our porta cabin sizes and specifications guide.

What People Use Porta Cabins For

A porta cabin is one of the most flexible structures you can buy because the same shell serves many jobs:

  • Site & construction offices — the most common use; a clean, cool office on an active site.
  • Security / guard cabins — compact, quick to place at gates and entries.
  • Shops & stalls — a ready commercial front.
  • Toilet & washroom blocks — see our porta cabins fitted with toilets.
  • Labour accommodation — durable living units for workforce housing.
  • Office cabins — for a dedicated office layout, see our porta cabin office units.

Customization Options

Because we manufacture in-house, almost everything is adjustable:

  • Size, layout, and number of rooms
  • Insulation level (for heat, cold, or sound)
  • Electrical load, lighting, fans, AC provision
  • Plumbing and washroom fittings
  • Door, window, and grill choices
  • External and internal finish, colour, and branding

Tell us the job the cabin has to do and we build it to fit — that is the difference between buying from a manufacturer and picking a fixed listing off a marketplace.

Porta Cabin Price — What Affects the Cost

There is no single "porta cabin price" because the cost follows the specification. The starting price shown with the product above is our published rate; your final figure depends on:

As a market reference, standard MS corrugated porta cabins in India are typically quoted around ₹1,000 per sq.ft plus GST. SAMAN quotes complete, specification-locked cabins instead — the standard 40×10 ft model on this page is ₹4,99,999 inclusive of all taxes, and every material behind that number is listed in the Specifications tab.

  • Size — larger footprint or extra rooms
  • Panel & insulation type — single-skin vs insulated sandwich panels
  • Flooring and finish level
  • Electrical and plumbing fit-out
  • Quantity — multiple units are usually more economical per unit
  • Delivery distance from our Bangalore or Greater Noida units

For lower-budget requirements, see our low-cost porta cabin range, and to move straight to purchase, our buy porta cabins page.

Freight is charged by distance — fixed ₹20,000 within Bengaluru city and ₹90–₹110 per km outstation by 40-ft open trailer, with loading/unloading of ₹2,000 arranged at site. Transit is typically 3–5 days once dispatched, within a total 7–21 working day order-to-installation window. Your exact price is confirmed after a short requirement discussion — send an enquiry and we will give you a clear figure.

Delivery & Installation

Your porta cabin is built and finished at our factory, then delivered ready to use:

  • Dispatch from our Bangalore unit (South) or Greater Noida unit (North), whichever is closer to your site.
  • Freight is distance-based — see the Shipping tab for city and per-km rates; transit is typically 3–5 days once dispatched.
  • Placement on a prepared level base or plinth; offloading and positioning are arranged with you at the time of dispatch.
  • Because the cabin arrives complete, there is no long on-site build — most units are usable very shortly after they land.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

We are a manufacturer, not a listing. That matters when you need a cabin that lasts and a supplier who answers after the sale:

  • Real manufacturing units in Bangalore (South) and Greater Noida (North) — GST-registered, not a reseller.
  • 500+ projects delivered across India.
  • Certified quality systems: ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environment), ISO 45001:2018 (safety), plus NSIC, DPIIT (Startup India), and Udyam MSME registration.
  • Real customer reviews from completed projects.
  • In-house control of frame, panels, fit-out, and finish — so quality and customization are ours to guarantee, not a third party's.

Porta Cabin FAQs

How much does a porta cabin cost?

The price depends on size, panel type, insulation, and fit-out. A published starting rate is shown with the product above; your exact cost is confirmed after a short requirement discussion.

What is the porta cabin price per square foot in India?

Market rates for a standard MS corrugated porta cabin in India typically run around ₹1,000 per sq.ft plus GST, with premium finishes higher. SAMAN prices complete cabins rather than loose per-sq.ft rates — our standard 40×10 ft site office is ₹4,99,999 inclusive of all taxes, with the full steel and material specification published on this page so you can see exactly what the price includes.

How long does a porta cabin last?

A SAMAN porta cabin is engineered for a 20–25 year service life. The welded MS frame carries a 5-year structural warranty and finishing carries 1–2 years. Lifespan depends on repainting the exterior every few years and keeping the base level — both simple site jobs.

Can a porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. The steel frame is designed to be lifted and transported, so you can relocate the cabin when your site or need changes. Every cabin has welded lifting hooks; after your project ends, the same unit lifts onto a trailer and relocates to the next site — many clients move cabins three or four times over their life.

Will it stay comfortable in heat and monsoon?

With insulated panels and correctly sloped roofing, porta cabins handle Indian summers and rains well. We match the insulation to your climate at quotation.

Do you make custom sizes?

Yes — every cabin is made to order. Share your rough size and use, and we build to fit.

How fast is delivery?

Freight is charged by distance — fixed ₹20,000 within Bengaluru city and ₹90–₹110 per km outstation by 40-ft open trailer, with loading/unloading of ₹2,000 arranged at site. Transit is typically 3–5 days once dispatched, within a total 7–21 working day order-to-installation window.

Do you deliver outside Bangalore?

Yes. We dispatch from Bangalore (South) and Greater Noida (North) to cover most of India.

What is your return policy?

A 7-day return window applies, with return transport paid by the customer.

What makes a porta cabin the right choice for a construction project?

No foundation, no permanent structure, no lengthy permissions. A porta cabin goes up in a day and comes down just as fast. You get a weatherproof, functional space from day one — and it moves to the next project when this one closes.

How fast can SAMAN deliver a porta cabin to a construction site?

Standard delivery and erection across South India is 7 working days from order confirmation. For custom sizes or configurations, allow 10–12 working days.

Do you supply porta cabins on rent?

Yes. Monthly rental is available for standard sizes. Send us your site location and project duration for a rental quote.

Do porta cabins come with electrical fittings included?

Every unit includes internal wiring, a switchboard, and light fixtures as standard. AC connection points are available on request. You connect to your site’s power source — we supply everything inside.

Get your porta cabin quote today.

  • Bangalore & South Zone: Call +91 88616 22859 · sales@samanportable.com
  • Delhi NCR & North Zone: Call +91 87960 39938 · ncr@samanportable.com
  • Or use Send Enquiry and we will call you back with a clear price.

Sizes and What You Get as Standard

Every porta cabin we supply is built with a mild steel frame, factory-made PUF panel insulation, and a single-skin steel roof. Standard fittings on every unit include one door, two windows, internal electrical wiring, and a switchboard.

Porta cabin in India

Size Floor Area Typical Use
10×10 ft 100 sq ft 2–3 person coordination room
10×12 ft 120 sq ft 3–4 person site office
10×20 ft 200 sq ft 5–6 person project office
20×20 ft 400 sq ft Multi-room or combined office + rest area
20×40 ft 800 sq ft Large site accommodation

Need something smaller? Our small portacabin page covers the compact range — exact dimensions, capacity, and what fits inside. Custom sizes are available for non-standard site layouts.

Which Porta Cabin Do You Need?

Most buyers fall into one of these four categories. Find yours and go straight to the right page.

Starting a new project and need a basic site office fast Our low cost porta cabin is the most ordered unit — 10×10 ft MS structure, basic fittings, Rs 2,15,000. Delivered in 7 days.

Running a contractor team of 4–6 people on site The site office porta cabin is built for construction project management — drawing table provision, staff seating, AC-ready. For general office use outside construction, the portacabin office page covers that instead.

Need the smallest possible unit — single person, compact footprint Our mini porta cabin is 6×8 ft. Single door, single person. Not a security cabin — for purpose-built guard posts, see our security guard cabin range.

Sourcing for a premium or long-term installation If the project is long-duration or the office is client-facing, see the luxury porta cabin range for premium interior fit-out options.

How We Deliver to Your Site

External view of porta cabin

  1. Share your requirement — site location, size, number of units, when you need it.
  2. Get a quote in 24 hours — itemized price covering cabin, transport, and erection.
  3. Confirm order — factory dispatch within 5 working days.
  4. Delivery and erection — our team sets up at your site. You arrange a flat surface and power connection. We handle everything else.

Every unit is quality-checked at our Bangalore factory before leaving — structure, panels, fittings, and electrical. If you specifically need a factory-built unit with documented pre-dispatch inspection for procurement compliance, the prefabricated porta cabin page covers that process in detail.

For South India orders, delivery and erection completes within 7 working days of dispatch. For sites outside South India, confirm lead time with us before committing to your project schedule.

Rent or Buy — A Quick Guide

Rent if your project runs under 6 months or you're on a single site. Lower upfront commitment, you return the cabin when the project closes.

Buy if you're running 2 or more concurrent projects, or the project runs 12 months or longer. At that point, purchase cost works out lower than cumulative rent — and the cabin moves with you to the next project.

Ready to purchase? The buy porta cabins page covers stock availability, payment terms, and confirmed lead times.

Porta Cabin Price Range

Porta cabin for toilet purpoe

A standard 10×10 ft MS porta cabin starts at Rs 2,15,000. This covers the cabin, delivery within 200 km of Bangalore, and erection at site.

What moves the price: size, MS frame thickness, additional doors or windows, AC provision, toilet attachment, or premium interior fitout. If you need a cabin with an attached bathroom, a porta cabin with attached toilet starts at Rs 2,65,000 for a 10×12 ft combined unit.

What stays fixed: MS structure, insulated panels, and site erection are included in every quote. No separate transport invoice.

Why Construction Companies Order from SAMAN

500+ projects delivered across highway, infrastructure, and industrial construction sites in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala. For long-duration projects on rough terrain — highway, dam, or industrial sites — contractors consistently specify our steel porta cabin for its heavier frame and resistance to site conditions.

7-day delivery commitment for standard configurations across South India.

After-delivery support — if something isn't right when the cabin arrives, we fix it. Not your problem to sort with a third party.

If your requirement is not construction-specific — retail, residential, or institutional use — we have a separate range for those applications. Browse all cabin types →

Porta cabin for office use

Get a quote in 24 hours.

Call or WhatsApp us with your site location, size requirement, and delivery date. We'll send you a clear, itemized price.

Request a free quote → or call us at 09708989937

specificationsHtml:
MS Corrugated Standard Porta Cabin — Full Technical Specification

Every SAMAN porta cabin is factory-built on a welded mild steel frame at our Bengaluru and Greater Noida units. The specification below is our standard build — the same sheet we submit for tenders and client approvals. Anything not listed here is confirmed at quotation.

Steel Structure

ComponentSection / SizeDetail
Bottom frame100×50×3 mm MS C channelISI standard or equivalent; primary load-bearing base
Bottom stiffeners100×50 C channel · 50×50 MS angle · 75×40 channel · MS square pipesReinforced at 4 ft intervals
Top frame50×50×1.6 mm MS square pipeMain roof perimeter support
Roof stiffeners50×50×1.2 mm + 50×40 / 40×40 / 50×25 / 25×25 mm pipesRoof stiffness and ceiling support
Corner posts / walls50×50×2 mm square pipe or 60×60 mm MS angleOverall wall thickness approx. 60 mm
Lifting hooksDesigned to cabin weightWelded lifting points for crane handling and relocation

Walls, Roof, Floor & Insulation

ElementSpecification
Exterior walls1.2 mm specially corrugated MS sheet (Tata/Jindal/equivalent), welded to frame
Roof1.4 mm MS corrugated sheet with drainage slope, sealed and flashed
Interior walls & ceiling8 mm pre-laminated MDF board, aluminium joint sections
Flooring18 mm Bison panel (self-tapping screws) + 1.3 mm vinyl finish — water-resistant, termite-protected
Roof insulation50 mm glass wool, 42 kg/m³ density
Wall insulation25 mm glass wool or 12 mm heatlon

Doors, Windows & Electrical

ItemSpecification
Main door7 ft × 3 ft, externally opening, 30×30 mm MS tubular frame, standard hardware and canopy
WindowsTwo-track aluminium sliding, 4 mm glass (Saint-Gobain/equivalent), quantity per layout
WiringConcealed PVC-insulated copper — 1.5 / 2.5 / 4 sq.mm (Polycab/Finolex/equivalent), 240V single-phase
ProtectionDistribution board with MCB protection per circuit
FittingsLED lights, 6A/16A 3-pin sockets, fan points, exhaust and AC provision per drawing (Crompton/Philips/Roma/Bajaj/equivalent)
Painting1 coat red oxide primer + 2 coats anti-rust enamel on all steel

Included as Standard vs Optional

Included: complete MS frame, corrugated exterior and roof, MDF interior and ceiling, Bison + vinyl floor, insulation, door and windows per layout, basic electrical with MCB, painting, lifting hooks. Optional / confirmed at quotation: toilet and plumbing (Cera/Parryware/equivalent), AC units, furniture, base support legs, foundation and civil work, third-party inspection and special compliance.

Warranty: 5-year structural warranty on the frame and base, 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life on the steel structure. Pre-dispatch inspection can be arranged for every order.
shippingHtml:
Porta Cabin Delivery — Real Freight, No Surprises

A finished porta cabin ships as a complete unit on an open 40-ft trailer. Total order-to-installation time is 7–21 working days. Unlike marketplace listings that hide freight until the last call, here is exactly how SAMAN charges it:

  • Within Bengaluru city: fixed ₹20,000 freight per cabin.
  • Outstation from Bengaluru: open 40-ft trailer at ₹90–₹110 per km depending on route and truck availability.
  • Loading/unloading at site: ₹2,000, arranged by the client/site (crane or forklift at the designated lifting hooks only).
  • North India: cabins for Delhi NCR and the North zone dispatch from our Greater Noida unit — freight quoted per route at enquiry.

Dispatch & Erection

  • Standard cabins are dispatch-ready in 7–21 working days depending on size, finish and order quantity; road transit typically adds 3–5 days for outstation routes.
  • The cabin arrives fully built — placed on your prepared level base and connected to power the same day.
  • You arrange: a level surface (PCC blocks/platform) and a power point. We handle everything else.
